title: Canadian Broad Bean Noodle Stir Fry
description: A light and flavorful stir fry made with Canadian broad beans, noodles, and a hint of mustardy taste.

ingredients.name: noodles
ingredients.amount: 8 oz, cooked according to package instructions

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced broad beans and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the broad beans.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, mustardy sauce, and grated ginger.
Pour the sauce over the noodles and broad beans, and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the chopped green onions and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Serve the stir fry hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
